dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible with irregular, scalloped perimeters of high-intensity light-grey pixels. These edges exhibit a sharp gradient transition into darker, charcoal-grey interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, high-intensity white pixel aggregates is observed in the anterior-lateral region. These clusters show a high core pixel concentration with no internal gradient, particularly dense near the front flipper insertion.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-lateral macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle. Smaller high-intensity blobs are arranged in a roughly linear configuration extending towards the dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The anterior flipper exhibits five distinct, high-contrast dark keratinized structures visible as a series of curved, pointed geometries against the surrounding pelt texture.
